articles.title: Netanyahu's Likud Holds High-Stakes Primaries: Only 15 Spots Actually Up for Grabs
articles.summary: Israel's ruling Likud party is holding primaries for the upcoming election, but Prime Minister Netanyahu has already locked in 11 of the top 30 list spots. That leaves just 15 realistic seats for other candidates to fight over—and the stakes couldn't be higher.

articles.title: Trump's Administration Has More Ultrawealthy Officials Than the Last Three Presidents Combined
articles.summary: A new Public Citizen report reveals that 57 Trump administration officials are worth at least $100 million—more than four times the combined total under Bush, Obama, and Biden. Eight Cabinet members are in that club, including two billionaires.

articles.title: Kushner Shuttles Between Hamas and Netanyahu, But Gaza Ceasefire Road Map Stalls
articles.summary: Jared Kushner met with Israeli PM Netanyahu on Monday, a day after meeting Hamas leaders in Cairo. Hamas says it accepts the U.S.-backed road map, but Israel demands full disarmament before any withdrawal. Regional powers are condemning Israel's rejection.
